notes.title: New Faction and Updated Demo
notes.content:
Over the past few months, we have been working on improvements to the Demo version, as well as fixing problems and bugs that appeared at the start.
Now we are ready to present you an updated Demo version.

[h2]Updated Demo version[/h2]

What we changed and added:
- A new faction —  Humans.
- Fee (a weekly reward that you can get by completing 5 investigations).
- Cards that you can create thanks to the clues.
- New type of card — Scene.
- The function of sending bug reports.
- Updated visual effects.
- Download screen.
- Icons replacing certain words in card texts.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38969625/3f6c46376caecd11e5b6fa288a2098fe314c8b25.png[/img]

[h2]New Faction[/h2]

We added a third faction — Humans. Along with them, the game has new mechanics of interaction with the deck and cards. So far, the faction does not have many cards, but more will appear over time. The Human Faction has added the following things to the game:

- Two new leaders with unique abilities: Randolph Carter and
Henry Armitage.
- New cards mechanics.
- New archetype.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38969625/3e9d656749851a9021f48cee11bdc6de56174e1f.png[/img]

[h2]Reward to all testers[/h2]
We would like to thank all the people who helped us find bugs and tested the demo version immediately after its release. As we promised, all participants will receive visual decorations. In addition, all players who register before April 20th will receive a card:
"Adrian Crow, the Broken".

The card will also be available to create with the help of clues.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38969625/ae37b74b2cf3e990d1f8ffbe61737cea3d458713.png[/img]
